datasheet_identity.title: ES3AB THRU ES3JB Surface Mount Fast Recovery Rectifier

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF hash matches the expected SHA-256 0cc0de327cc0967d325949c66d91824a2738577fcec2e28b0b72b102fac2c252.
The datasheet identifies the manufacturer as Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.; the conveyor manufacturer identity is normalized to hongjiacheng.
The ES3DB target is covered by the solid ES3AB-ES3DB trace in Fig. 3; forward points were digitized from the real plotted trace with its logarithmic current axis.

Fig. 4 plots typical reverse current against percent of rated peak reverse voltage for Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC. Points are reported in volts for ES3DB by converting the plotted percentage using VRRM = 200 V; reverse polarity and temperature are retained in the conditions.
The tabulated 1.0 V maximum forward voltage is a group value for ES3AB through ES3DB at IF = 3.0 A. The tabulated 2.0 uA maximum reverse current is at VR = VDC = 200 V and TA = 25 degC.

The 65 pF junction-capacitance value is typical at 4.0 V DC reverse bias and 1 MHz. The 35 ns reverse-recovery value is a maximum at IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, and IRR = 0.25 A; no recovery waveform was published.
VRRM = 200 V is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage. No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification was published, so both fields are null.
Fig. 1 forward-current derating and Fig. 2 peak forward-surge ratings were not extracted because they are ratings curves rather than forward or reverse diode electrical characteristics.
